findings.title: No active multi-region CloudTrail trail
findings.description: Trail cspm-demo-trail is multi-region and logging is on.
findings.remediation_hint: Create a multi-region CloudTrail trail and make sure logging is turned on.

findings.title: Security group allows open ingress to the internet
findings.description: Security group cspm-demo-vuln-sg allows 0.0.0.0/0 on port 22 (SSH).
findings.remediation_hint: Remove the 0.0.0.0/0 and ::/0 ingress rules for SSH (22), RDP (3389) or all ports.
